title: Co-area formula for real-valued integrands (Simon Ch. 6, 4.1 applied to q⁺ and q⁻)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P Borel, f : ℝ^P → ℝ Borel and G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P Borel. Write Hᵏ := μHE[k] and assume the co-area identity (CF): for every Borel g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞], t ↦ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹(t)} g dHⁿ is Lebesgue-a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹(t)} g dHⁿ dt = ∫_M |G| g dH^{n+1}. Let q : ℝ^P → ℝ be Borel with ∫_M |G||q| dH^{n+1} < ∞. Then (1) for L¹-a.e. t, q is Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ f⁻¹(t); (2) t ↦ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹(t)} q dHⁿ (Bochner integral, which is 0 when q is not integrable on the slice) is Lebesgue integrable on ℝ; (3) ∫_ℝ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹(t)} q dHⁿ dt = ∫_M |G| q dH^{n+1}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P), MeasurableSet M → Measurable f → Measurable G → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1]) → ∀ q : Euclid P → ℝ, Measurable q → ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * ENNReal.ofReal |q x| ∂μHE[n + 1] ≠ ∞ → (∀ᵐ t, IntegrableOn q (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) μHE[n]) ∧ Integrable (fun t => ∫ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, q x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫ t, ∫ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, q x ∂μHE[n] = ∫ x in M, ‖G x‖ * q x ∂μHE[n + 1]
